title: Coalition success probability
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, a set $J$ of coordinates, and a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$, the coalition success probability is the uniform probability that the input satisfies the condition that the coalition on $J$ can attain $b$ under $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The payload omits the definition of the condition that the coalition can attain the sign.
